title: A Falcon Dives Over 200 Miles an Hour, Fastest Animal on Earth

scenes.text: A bird can dive at over 200 miles an hour.
It's the peregrine falcon. It folds its wings and drops out of the sky.
A falcon named Frightful was clocked at 242 miles per hour in a dive.
That makes it the fastest animal on the planet.
It uses that speed to catch other birds in midair.
Over 200 miles an hour. From a bird.

description:
